summary.limits: Synthetic valid packed codes and BF16 scales/zeros; actual kernel shapes from prior CUDA trace. Changes launch geometry only, preserves original kernel source and enable_fp_fusion=False. Each timing is CUDA-event median of three graph replays of60 launches, bracketed by original geometry. Microbenchmark may have warmer caches and is not full-model throughput, quality, batching or serving evidence. Must validate real model original per-layer/logit and emitted-token controls separately before adoption.
